extraction.Name: Laura Desersa
extraction.Cancelled: said patent has not been cancelled
extraction.Refused/Protested: she made no application for a patent in fee to her allotment number 1116 ... the said patent was sent to her from the agency without her request
extraction.Recorded patent: she had the same recorded in the office of the Register of Deeds of Bennett County, South Dakota
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold and conveyed the said land to Charles Volts of Martin, South Dakota; that the said land was never mortgaged by this deponent
extraction.Buyer: Charles Volts of Martin, South Dakota for the sum of $2800.00
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: so far as affiant knows none of the said land has been sold for taxes or debts
extraction.Occupation/Income: she has no property and no means of livelihood other then her husband
extraction.NOTES: Land is Northwest Quarter of Section 16, Township 36 North of Range 38 West of the 6th Principal Meridian in Bennett County, South Dakota. Sold about two months after receiving patent. Affiant received only about $150.00 or $175.00 in cash; the remainder of consideration was paid in goods, wares and merchandise from Charles Volts's store in Martin, SD; affiant believes she did not receive the full amount of consideration and has never been able to receive an accounting. Husband Louis Desersa works at Warren-Lamb Lumber Company sawmill in Rapid City earning about $2.75 per day, supporting affiant and four children. Children: Clarence Desersa (14), Leo William Desersa (9), Aaron Garfield Desersa (8), Katherine Genevieve Desersa (4). Mental and physical condition about normal. Notary: Martha Bockert. Document dated May 20, 1929.
